name: skylark_check_flight_status
intent: Check the status of a SkyLark flight
description: Open Flight status in the SkyLark app, enter a flight number, search for it, and report the route, date, delay status, gate, and departure time shown in the result.
patterns: what's the status of my flight
what gate does this flight leave from

inputs.name: flight_number
inputs.description: The SkyLark flight number to look up

steps.intent: Type {{flight_number}} into the Flight number field
Tap Done to dismiss the keyboard
Tap Search to look up the status of {{flight_number}}

outputs.name: flight_status
outputs.near: SL 1190 · ATL → DEN · Sat, Nov 14, 2026 · Delayed 25 min · Gate A7 · Departs 2:45 PM

outputs.name: route
outputs.near: SL 1190 · ATL → DEN · Sat, Nov 14, 2026 · Delayed 25 min · Gate A7 · Departs 2:45 PM

outputs.name: flight_date
